status: No strategy has been evaluated. No verified odds, game logs, or player-prop data were available to this session.

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.proposal: Every input traced to an official or licensed source with a link.

gates.name: Minimum sample size
gates.proposal: Threshold set per strategy (proposed default to be decided; see Q-09).

gates.name: Time-based out-of-sample test
gates.proposal: Fit on earlier seasons, test on later ones. No random splits.

gates.name: Beat a no-skill baseline
gates.proposal: Compare to the implied probability of the market price (requires odds; Q-07).

gates.name: Closing-line value
gates.proposal: Measure whether originated prices beat the closing market price (requires odds; Q-07).

gates.name: Multiple-testing control
gates.proposal: Correct significance for the number of strategies on the leaderboard.

gates.name: Measured correlation for parlays
gates.proposal: Joint frequencies measured from game logs; independence assumed only where tested.

gates.name: Stability across windows
gates.proposal: Result holds across at least two separate time windows.

gates.name: Legal / compliance
gates.proposal: No public betting-related output until the legal review (Q-04) is complete.

note: Gate definitions are this project's proposals (methodology), not facts from an external source. They are marked as proposals on the site.
